## 🔍 About this sample project

You will listen to short scripted clips and answer a few questions about each one.

- #### Letters read one by one are written in CAPITALS with spaces. 
"A B C" means the speaker says each letter separately.
- #### Numbers are written out in words.
Say them exactly as written.

### Question A. Does the audio match the spoken form? (Yes / No)

| Spoken form                    | Audio                             | Answer | Why                     |
| ------------------------------ | --------------------------------- | ------ | ----------------------- |
| I was born in nineteen ninety. | I was born in nineteen ninety.    | ✅ YES  | Exact match             |
| I was born in nineteen ninety. | I was born in one nine nine zero. | ❌ NO   | Number read differently |

> 💡 Choose NO if even one word differs from the spoken form.

### Question B. Is the spoken form a natural reading? (Yes / No)

| Written form                  | Spoken form                                | Answer | Why                     |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------ | ----------------------- |
| Write to sam.lee\@example.com | Write to sam dot lee at example dot com    | ✅ YES  | Typical reading         |
| Write to sam.lee\@example.com | Write to sam dot lee snail example dot com | ❌ NO   | Nobody says it that way |

### Question C. Does the sentence make sense? (Да / Нет)

| Sentence                   | Answer |
| -------------------------- | ------ |
| My order number is QX1234. | ✅ ДА   |
